layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Minimal whitespace-heavy layout with generous breathing room.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use p-8, p-12, p-20, py-24 for section padding.
layout_and_spacing.grid: CSS Grid for cards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) with gap-8 or gap-12.
layout_and_spacing.section_dividers: Subtle 1px border-t using #E5E7EB, or rely entirely on whitespace and alternating background colors (Off-white vs Pure White).

components.buttons: Clean, solid or outlined. No gradients, no heavy shadows. Use solid accent color or transparent with accent border.
components.cards: Flat, sharp edges or max 4px border-radius. No heavy box-shadow. Use 1px border of #E5E7EB or just rely on image + text with whitespace.

animations.principles: Subtle, purposeful, clean. Remove cinematic intensity.

recommendations.premium_effects: Remove 3D word entrance, gold sparkle, and heavy Ken Burns. Remove the heavy gold scroll rail and mouse-tilt parallax, as they clutter the minimal aesthetic. If a scroll indicator is heavily desired, replace it with a minimal 2px top progress bar in the brand accent color.
recommendations.allowed_motion: Simple opacity fade-ins, subtle y-axis translation (e.g., translate-y-4 to 0), and clean image scale on hover (scale-105 with long transition).

section_guidance.hero: Bright living-room image, no cinematic dark overlays. Split layout (Text on left, Image on right) OR overlapping white card over a clean image. Keep overlay opacity low (max bg-black/10 if needed). Outfit bold but clean heading.
section_guidance.about: Change from dark dining-room to a bright, clean two-column layout. Use a light beige/cream surface block with a sharp, high-quality image. Emphasize whitespace.
section_guidance.portfolio: 3x3 grid of clean image cards. Image above, minimal text (Project Name, Category) below. No heavy borders. Hover effect: subtle image zoom within container.
section_guidance.services: Grid of 4 minimal icon/image cards. White background, simple visual, clean heading, light paragraph.
section_guidance.why_choose_us: Remove dark background. Use off-white background (#FAF9F6). Simple list or bento grid with large light grey numerals (01, 02) and text beside them.
section_guidance.testimonials: Clean simple cards (white) on a subtle background. Keep the carousel but remove any heavy framing.
section_guidance.contact: Minimal input fields (e.g., border bottom only or light full border). Clean solid CTA button. Branch addresses in simple typography.
section_guidance.footer: Muted background (#F3F2EC or pure white), clean layout, simple links. Ensure CTA is visible but not overwhelming.

mobile_first_notes: Stack columns cleanly with gap-8. Images must not exceed 80vh on mobile. Ensure generous horizontal padding (px-4 or px-6). Keep typography scale readable on small screens (max text-4xl for H1).

do: Use ample whitespace between and within sections (py-24, gap-12).
Use Outfit for headings and Inter for body text.
Stick to the muted neutral palette with only Terracotta/Rust as the accent.
dont: Do NOT use heavy shadows, gradients, or dark cinematic overlays.
Do NOT use the old fi-* cinematic animation classes.
Do NOT center-align everything; use left-alignment for modern editorial feel.
Do NOT change the navigation structure, page layout order, or existing content.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement these guidelines strictly. Overhaul the existing tailwind and custom CSS classes. Remove all heavy cinematic animations. Swap fonts to Outfit/Inter. Apply the new neutral + terracotta color palette. Simplify layouts to be card-based with high whitespace. Preserve all existing content and nav structure. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid.
